story.title: Kissht Fintech Makes Strong Stock Market Debut With Shares Up 22% After Rs 926 Crore IPO
story.summary: Digital lending platform Kissht made a strong debut on Indian stock markets with its shares rising 22% on listing day, following a Rs 926 crore IPO comprising both a fresh issue of shares and an offer for sale. The listing reflects continued investor confidence in India's digital lending sector despite regulatory scrutiny around consumer credit practices. Kissht primarily targets underserved borrowers seeking small-ticket consumer loans, operating in a segment that remains largely untouched by traditional banks.
